citations.excerpt: he chose, in 1309, Avignon as his residence. Thus began the so-called Babylonian captivity, or Avignon exile, of the papacy, which lasted more than seventy years and included seven popes, all Frenchmen

facts.value: Period when the popes resided at Avignon in France rather than Rome.
